improvements: Private Cloud images now contain only the Node.js runtime libraries and package inventory required by the shipped services.
The reduced runtime remains non-root and preserves CA certificates, time-zone data, DNS resolution, and writable temporary storage.
fixes: Private Cloud release scans no longer fail on an unused OpenSSL package inherited from the upstream distroless image.
knownIssues: Dedicated and Private Cloud lifecycle certification remains preview-only as described in the release support policy.

improvements: Adjacent Thinking updates now appear as one compact visual group with navigation in the header.
Per-turn timing expands inline, and failed turns without an assistant reply retain their timing details.
Session storage review now provides safer cleanup planning, corruption isolation, and clearer retained-data accounting.
The workspace browser, sidebar Session cards, full-screen terminal behavior, and responsive Dashboard layouts are more consistent.
fixes: Copilot CLI discovery and queued message delivery remain available across local redeployments.
Cleanup plans no longer invalidate themselves while inspecting interrupted external-runtime Sessions.
Socket.IO now uses a patched Engine.IO dependency chain.
Dedicated Ingress shutdown waits for active admission reconciliation before releasing its storage.
knownIssues: Dedicated and Private Cloud lifecycle certification remains preview-only as described in the release support policy.

improvements: Running Sessions in the left sidebar now use the same ambient text treatment as Thinking activity.
The Desktop connection screen now separates first-time setup from endpoint changes.
Manual Desktop update checks now report when the installed version is current.
fixes: Conversation history hidden with `/clear` now stays hidden for that Session after refresh, reconnect, or service restart.
The right sidebar now defaults to Files and restores the last selected tab independently for each Session.
Linux Desktop microphone requests now use an explicit, origin-scoped native permission flow.
Copilot CLI discovery now remains available after a local redeployment.
knownIssues: Desktop microphone permission has been validated by automated native tests; installation still requires the normal operating-system permission prompt.
